children: HDFC Bank shares remained in focus on Friday, with the stock trading largely flat amid mixed buying and selling activity.
The stock was trading at ₹731.40 at 10.42 am on the NSE, compared with its previous close of ₹728.90. It opened at ₹723 and moved in a range of ₹723 to ₹733.20 during the session so far.
The order book showed a higher sell quantity, with sell orders accounting for 57.39 per cent at 12,54,170 units, while buy quantity stood at 42.61 per cent at 9,31,325 units.
Trading activity was also strong, with 55.53 lakh HDFC Bank shares changing hands, involving a traded value of around ₹405 crore.
At the current price, HDFC Bank’s market capitalisation stood at around ₹11.27 lakh crore, while its adjusted price-to-earnings ratio was 14.02.

The stock has remained largely subdued in the near term. HDFC Bank shares have delivered an absolute return of 0.04 per cent over the past week and 0.52 per cent over the past month. On a year-to-date basis, however, the stock has declined 26 per cent.
Investors are also tracking the bank’s upcoming September-quarter earnings on October 17, 2026.
The upcoming results are likely to be closely watched for trends in loan and deposit growth, net interest income, margins, asset quality and profitability.

title: HDFC Bank shares trade flat, Q2 results in focus
